head: codex/5854-sprint5-readiness-current
title: [v0.92][readiness] Prepare Sprint 5 without starting child work
body:
Part of danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5854

Prepares the v0.92 Sprint 5 coordination umbrella and five operative child readiness contracts without binding or executing any child deliverable.

Scope:
- prepares #5835, #5836, #5838, #5839, and #5840 with explicit dependency gates and issue-owned proof surfaces; all remain initialized with null branch/worktree and pending plans
- records legacy WP-24 #5844 as product/GitHub complete while typed closeout continues asynchronously
- excludes WP-24A #5845 as an independently owned out-of-band stream that cannot gate Sprint 5 readiness, execution, review, or closeout
- retains digest-bound typed GitHub issue/PR readbacks, freshness, closing-relation, and merge-ancestry evidence
- preserves external deployment and publication as operator-only authority

Validation:
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5854/validate-sprint-readiness.rb`
- typed `csdlc-validate issue --issue 5854`
- typed `csdlc-doctor --issue 5854`
- `git diff --check`

Independent exact-head review approved implementation head `5401ef042608cc6c0a45c746f857c4317f6b2179` with no actionable findings. Typed review truth is recorded at generation 24.

This is a non-closing readiness publication. It does not start Sprint 5, execute children, close #5854, merge this PR, deploy demos, or publish articles/media. Tooling issue agent-logic/agent-design-language#74 remains independently owned and was not modified.
